steps.what: Advise internal management or business partners on compliance programs
Advise them on implementation or operation of those programs

tasks.design: The manager advises internal management or business partners on the implementation or operation of compliance programs. The advice stays at full effort. No note issues the advice by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager gave the advice in the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: What to advise stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not advise beyond the program they know.
tasks.altitude: The advice stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear the advice from the manager
reach.learn: Which points the manager refused to give.

evidence.claim: Advising management or a partner on a compliance program stays a conversation.

assumptions: The brief is the policy, case, or site the manager already holds. A blank field is left blank.
No employee, auditor, or caller is scored. Upkeep is zero.
The rules applied are those in force. No foreign filing process is invented.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every piece of advice is still given by the manager. High: the same conversation remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Design improvements in communication, monitoring, or enforcement
Implement those improvements in compliance standards by hand

tasks.design: The manager designs or implements improvements in communication, monitoring, or enforcement of compliance standards. The design stays at full effort. Enforcement is not issued by a rule. Staff are not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager designed the improvement and put it in place.
tasks.enabler_now: No rule enforces a standard by itself.
tasks.still_hard: What to change, and how to enforce it, stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not automate a sanction.
tasks.altitude: Design and implementation stay at full effort. Enforcement is not automatic.

reach.task: Apply only the change the manager has set

tasks.short: Work with human resources on discipline

steps.what: Collaborate with human resources departments on compliance cases
Ensure implementation of consistent disciplinary action strategies
Hear cases of compliance standard violations in person

tasks.design: The manager collaborates with human resources departments to ensure the implementation of consistent disciplinary action strategies in cases of compliance standard violations. The decision stays at full effort and with people. No sanction is issued by a rule. Staff are not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager and human resources decided together.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a violation leads to action stays with the people in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not record a sanction that was not decided.
tasks.altitude: The disciplinary decision stays at full effort. Nobody is scored.

reach.task: Decide the case with the manager

evidence.claim: A disciplinary decision stays a conversation with human resources. Staff are not scored.

role.altitude: The compliance manager still judges a breach, a sanction, and a policy change. A policy or a report is sent or filed only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An employee reaches the manager directly with a confidential report.
A colleague receives only a policy the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required flag, interval, or figure is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep investigations, sanctions, and policy changes in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every management report traces to a stored figure, and the manager still writes what it means.
